blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.translation` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of translations. It sends a request to the
[List Translations](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#translations\_gettranslations)
API route.

blocks.html:
This method retrieves the settings for the translations for a given entity type or all entity types if no entity type is provided.
It sends a request to the
[Get Translation Settings](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#translations\_gettranslationssettings) API route.

types.name: query
types.description: The query parameters which can optionally include the entity type to get the settings for and whether to get the settings for active/inactive entities only.

children.name: entity_type
children.description: The entity type to get the settings for (e.g., "product").

children.name: is_active
children.description: Whether to get the settings for active/inactive entities only.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: translation_settings
children.description: A mapping of entity types to their tranlsation settings.

blocks.html:
This method retrieves a paginated list of entities for a given entity type with only their
translatable fields.
It sends a request to the
[Get Translation Entities](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#translations\_gettranslationentities) API route.

types.name: query
types.description: The query parameters including the entity type and pagination configurations.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: type
children.description:
The entity type to retrieve (e.g., "product", "product\_variant").
This determines which table to query and which translatable fields to return.

children.name: id
children.description: Filter by entity ID(s). Can be a single ID or an array of IDs.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

types.name: Promise
types.description: The paginated list of entities with their translatable fields.

children.name: data
children.description:
The list of entities with their translatable fields.
Each entity contains only the fields configured as translatable
for that entity type in the translation settings, plus all
translations for all locales.

children.name: count
children.description: The total count of entities.

children.name: offset
children.description: The offset of the current page.

children.name: limit
children.description: The limit of items per page.

blocks.html:
This method retrieves the statistics for the translations for a given entity type or all entity types if no entity type is provided.
It sends a request to the
[Get Translation Statistics](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#translations\_gettranslationsstatistics) API route.

types.name: query
types.description: The query parameters which can optionally include the entity type to get the statistics for.

children.name: locales
children.description: The locales to check translations for. Can be a single locale or an array of locales.

children.name: entity_types
children.description: The entity types to get statistics for. Can be a single entity type or an array.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: statistics
children.description: Statistics by entity type.

children.name: expected
children.description: Expected number of translated fields.

children.name: translated
children.description:
Actual number of translated fields. This doesn't count
translations that are null or empty.

children.name: missing
children.description:
Number of missing translations for expected translatable
fields.

children.name: by_locale
children.description: Breakdown of statistics by locale.
